name: azure-visio-assistant
description: AI-powered Azure architecture diagram creation with Visio and draw.io output, WAF/CAF validation, and 200+ reference architectures.

chatParticipants.name: azureVisio
chatParticipants.description: Create, validate, and export Azure architecture diagrams using natural language. Supports WAF/CAF validation, SKU recommendations, and Visio/Draw.io export.

commands.name: draw
commands.description: Draw an Azure architecture diagram from a description

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Run WAF and CAF validation on the current diagram

commands.name: sku
commands.description: Get SKU recommendations and live pricing for resources

commands.name: save
commands.description: Save the current diagram as Visio (.vsdx), Draw.io (.drawio), or Mermaid (.mmd)

azureVisio.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter with visio_mcp installed. Leave empty to auto-detect from the workspace .venv.

azureVisio.mcpServerPath.description: Path to the visio_mcp source directory. Leave empty to auto-detect from the workspace.

azureVisio.autoStartServer.description: Automatically start the MCP server when the extension activates.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Azure Visio AI Assistant
walkthroughs.description: Create production-quality Azure architecture diagrams with natural language, validate against WAF & CAF, and export to Visio or Draw.io.

steps.title: Chat with @azureVisio
steps.description:
Open Copilot Chat and type ``@azureVisio`` followed by a description of the architecture you want.

For example:
- ``@azureVisio draw a 3-tier web app``
- ``@azureVisio draw ai landing zone``
- ``@azureVisio draw microservices with event-driven architecture``

[Open Copilot Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

steps.title: Load a Reference Architecture
steps.description:
Start from one of 16 proven Microsoft reference architecture templates.

[Load Reference Architecture](command:azureVisio.loadReferenceArch)

steps.title: Validate with WAF & CAF
steps.description:
Score your diagram against the Well-Architected Framework (5 pillars) and Cloud Adoption Framework (naming, organization, governance).

[Run WAF Validation](command:azureVisio.validateWAF)
[Run CAF Validation](command:azureVisio.validateCAF)

steps.title: Implement Improvements
steps.description:
Ask ``@azureVisio implement all improvements`` to automatically fix WAF/CAF findings — add private endpoints, multi-region failover, route tables, DDoS protection, and more.

[Open Copilot Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

steps.title: Save Your Diagram
steps.description:
When you're happy with the architecture, tell ``@azureVisio save`` or use the command palette. You'll be prompted to choose the save location and format (.vsdx, .drawio, or .mmd).

[Save Diagram](command:azureVisio.saveDiagram)

steps.title: Get SKU & Pricing Guidance
steps.description:
Ask ``@azureVisio get sku recommendations for my diagram`` to get live Azure pricing and tier guidance for each resource.

[Open Copilot Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)
